post.summary: Send a Sign-in code to an email
post.description: The answer is the same whether or not the email has an Account.

post.summary: Sign in with the Sign-in code last sent to an email
post.description: The first right code for an email creates its Account. The answer is the new Session's token.

delete.summary: End every Session of the Account, this one included

post.summary: Sign in with a Google identity token
post.description: The backend verifies the token with Google's keys; the first sign-in of an email creates its Account, and an email with an Account reaches it, whatever Sign-in method made it (ADR 0047). The answer is the new Session's token.

message.default: The token is for another app

delete.summary: Delete the Session's Account at once and for good
delete.description: Its Sessions and sign-in methods go with it, and so does any Sign-in code waiting for its email. There is no grace period; the same email can sign in again to a new, empty Account.
The Account's other Sessions go on.

post.summary: Share a Collection behind a link
post.description: Stores the Collection as it is now and answers the link's id and its URL, `https://<linkDomain>/c/<id>`. The backend checks the shape, not whether the Entries are in a pack: a name of 1 to 60 characters once trimmed, 1 to 200 Entries, each once. A link never changes and never expires; it is kept with its Edition, name, Entry ids and the time it was made only: no Account, no device id, no IP address (ADR 0058).

get.description: The Collection as it was stored when it was shared: its Edition, its name and its Entry ids in its order. An unknown id answers 404 and a malformed id answers 400. Reading a link is not limited (ADR 0058).

post.summary: Count the changes of marks and Favorites a device made
post.description: Each event names an Entry once and changes its known, unknown and saved counts by −1, 0 or +1; a saved +1 also adds to the Entry’s Favorites adds of the current ISO week (UTC). A request names 1 to 100 Entries and is counted whole or not at all. The backend keeps the totals only: no Account, no device id, no IP address (ADR 0060).

get.summary: The Community Counters of several Entries
get.description: Known, unknown and saved for each Entry named in `entries`, comma-separated, 1 to 100 of them, each once; an Entry nobody counted answers zeros. The answer names the Entries in the order asked.

get.summary: The Community Word of the last ISO week
get.description: The Entry most added to Favorites in the last full ISO week (UTC), with its adds, the lower Entry id winning a tie; none when nobody added anything (ADR 0060).

get.summary: The Feature Switches the owner turned off remotely
get.description: A remote switch only turns a feature off: a feature is on when the Edition's config turns it on and it is not off here (ADR 0040).

304.description: The switches the app keeps are these

post.summary: Report a mistake in an Entry
post.description: The backend checks the report's shape, not whether its Entry is in a pack, and keeps it with its time of arrival only: no Account, no device id, no IP address (ADR 0056). A comment has at most 500 characters once trimmed and is empty when there is none; type other needs one.

post.summary: Keep a device's changes of its records
post.description: Each change replaces the record kept under its key only when its change time is later; a change time later than the server's own time counts as the server's. A change that is not later is ignored without an error: the next pull answers the record kept. A key has at most 200 characters and a value at most 8 KB as compact JSON in UTF-8, nested at most 32 levels deep; a push with one over is BAD_REQUEST. An Account keeps at most 20 000 records in an Edition, tombstones included; a push that would go over is TOO_MANY_RECORDS. Either is refused whole.

get.summary: The records kept after a cursor
get.description: The records changed after the cursor, in the order the server kept them, with the cursor to ask after next.
